description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/Dashboard/SaveSuccessPathEvent. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Record a Success Path button view or click. Use when: Dashboard telemetry for authenticated users, including the first-product flow. Input: Header channel: an accessible ChannelOAuthId. Body: numeric mission, action and eventType (1 visible, 2 clicked). Output: 204 on acceptance, 400 for invalid values, 404 for an inaccessible channel. Search terms: dashboard savesuccesspathevent. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.
